name: @aise/solution-boq
description: AISE deterministic solution BOQ derivation (PROD-025): turns a validated interactive solution version into an auditable, versioned, derived building BOQ with bidirectional BOQ-line ↔ solution-step traceability. Pure deterministic computation over @aise/solution-contract objects and @aise/solution-engine outputs — no network, no clock reads, no randomness, no I/O in the core, and NO write path into any source BOQ store (the generated BOQ is a separate derived projection).
